headline: Israel releases 9 of 10 settler suspects to house arrest after attacks on US journalist + European diplomats
dek: An Israeli court ordered the release of 9 of 10 Israeli settler suspects to house arrest after masked-settler attacks on Washington Post photojournalist Heidi Levine (hospitalized, finger surgery) and on French, Belgian, Polish diplomats + a French mayor in the West Bank; one suspect remains in…
sources: Honenu (settler law firm) via AJ; Guterres X post; Yesh Din
fault_line: Diplomats and journalists attacked — is Israeli justice deterring settler violence or shielding it?

sections.what_happened: An Israeli court ordered the release of 9 of 10 Israeli settler suspects to house arrest after masked-settler attacks on Washington Post photojournalist Heidi Levine (hospitalized, finger surgery) and on French, Belgian, Polish diplomats + a French mayor in the West Bank; one suspect remains in custody. UN SG Guterres posted the OPT situation is 'out of control' with aid 'severely restricted' in Gaza and daily settler attacks in the West Bank.
sections.what_verified: AJ breaking page with Honenu attribution; separate verified reporting of the diplomat attack earlier in the week; Guterres quote is on-record X.
sections.what_disputed: Israel says investigation continues; officials frame incidents as isolated. Rights group Yesh Din counters: 'In the vast majority of attacks against Palestinians, no arrests are made at all.'
sections.why_matters: Nine of ten suspects walked free within days — and the UN secretary-general says it's out of control. The quiet file beneath the carrier headlines.
sections.context: Background: West Bank — CAUGHT-UP (Oct 22): Israel releases 9 of 10 settler suspects to house arrest after attacks on US journalist + European diplomats; Guterres calls situation 'out of control'
